<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="720" height="520" viewBox="0 0 720 520" role="img" aria-labelledby="map-title map-desc">
<title id="map-title">Synthetic geometry map</title>
<desc id="map-desc">Render useful mixed geometry as deterministic inline SVG. Audience: GIS reviewer. CRS OGC:CRS84 longitude/latitude. Inline deterministic SVG; no basemap, labels, scale, scripts, or external resources.</desc>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="720" height="520" fill="#0f172a"/>
<rect x="48" y="52" width="624" height="416" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1"/>
<g id="geojson-primitives">
<path d="M 48 468 L 672 468 L 672 52 L 48 52 L 48 468 Z M 256 364 L 464 364 L 464 239.2 L 256 239.2 L 256 364 Z" fill="#1e3a8a" fill-opacity="0.55" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<polyline points="256,364 360,312 516,280.8" fill="none" stroke="#67e8f9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="152,416 204,384.8" fill="none" stroke="#67e8f9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="461" y="257" width="6" height="6" fill="#fef08a"/>
<rect x="565" y="215.4" width="6" height="6" fill="#fef08a"/>
<rect x="617" y="194.6" width="6" height="6" fill="#fef08a"/>
</g>
<g id="legend">
<rect x="472" y="16" width="232" height="86" rx="6" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#334155"/>
<text x="488" y="38" fill="#e0f2fe" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="12">GeoJSON geometry counts</text>
<text x="488" y="58" fill="#e0f2fe" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11">Features 4; Positions 18</text>
<text x="488" y="76" fill="#e0f2fe" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11">Pt 2; Line 2; Poly 1</text>
<text x="488" y="94" fill="#e0f2fe" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="11">CRS84 extent</text>
</g>
<text x="16" y="504" fill="#e0f2fe" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="10">Source: local GeoJSON source; sha256 00b5ef9d135d. 0 warning(s). No scale or basemap.</text>
</svg>

viewport.fit: fit-to-extent with fixed padding; degenerate extents expanded deterministically

limitations: Inline SVG only; no durable storage or filesystem artifact is written.
No basemap, map labels, representative fraction, scale bar, projection transform, geocoding, classification, statistics, or publication.
Only RFC 7946 CRS84 longitude/latitude GeoJSON coordinates are supported; source properties and feature names are not rendered.
Geometry drawing is a deterministic preview, not an OGC/GEOS topology validation or cartographic generalization.
